notes: Phase 6 Part 2 intelligence-layer expectations (diagnostic, not a vuln advisory). Covers single-request chaining honesty (cases[]), temporal multi-step detection, and what-if counterfactual baselines. Statuses follow docs/attack-graph.md; Predictive/Hypothetical artifacts are NEVER current vulnerabilities.

cases.chain: public proxy fetch -> confused deputy / ssrf -> internal token store
cases.notes: Server fetches an attacker-named URL with its own trusted network position; internal token endpoint is reachable server-side with no enforced boundary.

cases.chain: reflected-xss (/profile/preview) and open-redirect (/go) — same file, unrelated
cases.notes: Adversarial bait: no shared data/control flow. Must NOT be chained; two standalone dead-end findings are the correct outcome.

cases.chain: register -> verify -> reset lifecycle (temporal, not a single-request chain)
cases.notes: The lifecycle is a temporal chain (see temporal[]); single-request attack-path composition should NOT fabricate a hop chain across these independent requests.

temporal.notes: Steps co-locate in one module in the expected order → LIKELY, never CONFIRMED.

whatif_baseline.notes: Every what-if scenario output MUST be hypothetical:true and status PREDICTIVE — never presented as a current vulnerability.

unrestricted_egress.notes: confused_deputy exposes a credential asset + SSRF pivot, so an unrestricted-egress counterfactual should predict an exfiltration path.

remove_authz.notes: May be 0 if no effective control is present to remove — the engine must NOT fabricate one.
